reason: My whole business runs out of my Gmail stars and flags, and I'm not moving that into an app from a company I've never heard of that could fold next year. Maybe I'd poke at the free plan, but I wouldn't pay $12 a month on what I earn just to replace a habit that mostly works.
objection: If they shut down, my client history and follow-ups go with them, and an export file doesn't help much when my daily routine was built around their app.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing another freelancer I trust use it for a year without problems, and it reminding me about follow-ups I forgot right inside my email without me changing how I work.
